hotspots.title: Colombia’s far-right presidential runoff sparks global right-wing celebration
hotspots.blurb: Far-right candidate Abelardo de la Espriella won Colombia's first-round presidential vote, advancing to a June 21 runoff against leftist Iván Cepeda. International right-wing figures, including Javier Milei and Santiago Abascal, hailed the result as a rejection of socialism and a victory for freedom.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to its symbolic resonance with global right-wing movements, framing the election as a moral and ideological battleground against socialism.

hotspots.title: AfD’s internal leadership battles intensify
hotspots.blurb: Germany’s far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) is embroiled in internal power struggles ahead of state elections. The party’s radical factions are pushing for stricter migration policies and ‘remigration’ plans, while moderates attempt to soften its image. Leadership contests, such as the election of Dario Seifert as general secretary, highlight deep divisions.
hotspots.affect: The leadership crisis is charged due to the AfD’s rising electoral prospects and its potential to govern, which amplifies fears of far-right extremism in mainstream politics.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s governance and economic policies under scrutiny
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei’s libertarian economic reforms face growing criticism amid internal conflicts, corruption scandals, and rising poverty. His government’s austerity measures, privatization plans, and clashes with unions and the Catholic Church have sparked protests and legal challenges, while his approval ratings fluctuate.
hotspots.affect: Milei’s policies are a focal point due to their radical nature and high-stakes impact on Argentina’s economy and society, generating both fervent support and intense opposition.

hotspots.title: Trump’s Iran deal negotiations dominate coverage
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump’s administration is negotiating a potential ceasefire and nuclear deal with Iran, with Trump demanding stricter terms. The negotiations have sparked global tensions, with Trump threatening military action if Iran rejects the deal. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s remarks at the Shangri-La Dialogue further escalated concerns.
hotspots.affect: The Iran deal is charged due to its geopolitical implications, Trump’s unpredictable approach, and the high risk of military escalation, which fuels both alarm and partisan contention.

hotspots.title: Hungary’s EU funds deal sparks political turmoil
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar secured a €16.4 billion EU funds deal, but the agreement has triggered a political crisis. Magyar demanded the resignation of President Tamás Sulyok and other officials, accusing them of obstructing reforms. Sulyok refused, leading to a constitutional standoff and public protests.
hotspots.affect: The standoff is charged due to its implications for Hungary’s democratic institutions, EU relations, and the balance of power between Magyar’s government and opposition forces.
